notes: Source-of-truth inventory of every Cloudflare surface relevant to cf-monitor. Companion to cloudflare-api-surface.md. Research-only — does not commit cf-monitor to implementing any of these. v1.1.0 folded in live-probe corrections (2026-05-27 Scout token); v1.2.0 folds in the 2026-05-28 Billing Read probe against the Platform account: /billing/profile (200, PII-heavy contact info, not wired), /billing/history (200, billing-authoritative past invoices, possible future ingestion), /billing/usage (200 with ?time_delta=day only — NOT the Billable Usage API; generic metric query with no per-product cost, not wired); R2 ListBucket reclassified unknown 2026-05-28 (warned, not counted) — final A vs B still awaits a per-operation invoice. v1.3.0 (2026-05-28) records Tier 2 implementation: collect-queue-realtime (hourly), discover-pages-projects (daily), discover-vectorize-indexes (daily, metadata only); /usage now carries per-section confidence labels. v1.4.0 (2026-05-28, Phase 5) ships Tier 2 Part F: opt-in `cf-monitor init --register-budget-alert <threshold>` subscribes a CF notification policy to billing_budget_alert (email or webhook recipient). The $-threshold itself must be set in the CF dashboard (API limitation). New `cf-monitor probe alerting` diagnostic added. v1.5.0 (2026-05-28, Phase 7) ships the Protection Coverage report: `GET /protection` + `npx cf-monitor protection` audit-only endpoint producing a heuristic 0–100 score and classified findings across 10 categories (billing/budget alert/queue/pages/vectorize/R2/runtime SDK/AI gateway/worker CPU/safe-mode). Destructive Tier-3 controls deferred. See docs/protection-coverage.md.

Decision recorded in billing-endpoints-follow-up.md Decision A″: do not wire.

surfaces.cfMonitorUse: Possible future ingestion for `last N months actual spend` panel. Gated on 4-test pre-condition list in billing-endpoints-follow-up.md.

surfaces.name: Billing usage
dataExposed: result: { rows, data[{metrics: [[…]]}], data_lag, min, max, totals, time_intervals[[since, until]], query: { dimensions, metrics, since, until, time_delta, limit } }
surfaces.cfMonitorUse: NOT wired. NOT the long-hoped programmatic Billable Usage API. Generic time-series metric query (caller supplies metrics/dimensions/since/until/time_delta/limit). No per-product breakdown, no $-cost field. Default metric is streamMinutesViewed. Redundant with GraphQL Analytics. Decision A → branch C: do not wire.
caveats: Undocumented endpoint, verified 2026-05-28.
Bare path 400s with 'time delta "minute" doesn't exist'; ?time_delta=day is the minimum accepted bucket.
Full metric vocabulary is unknown — probe did not enumerate which metric names are accepted.
NOT a cost-data source — caller must specify metrics; response carries no $-cost field.

recommendations.label: P0 — resolved by 2026-05-28 Billing Read probe
items: /billing/usage is NOT a programmatic Billable Usage API — it's a generic time-series metric query with no per-product cost. Decision: do not wire. (Decision A → branch C in billing-endpoints-follow-up.md.)
/billing/profile is PII-heavy account contact info with no cost data — do not wire. (Decision A″.)

/billing/history is billing-authoritative for past invoices and is a candidate for a future `last N months actual spend` panel — gated on the 4-test pre-condition list in billing-endpoints-follow-up.md. Not in scope for the current correctness pass.

recommendations.label: verified already implemented
items: Plan detection via /accounts/{id}/subscriptions
5 GraphQL Analytics datasets (workersInvocationsAdaptive, d1AnalyticsAdaptiveGroups, kvOperationsAdaptiveGroups, r2OperationsAdaptiveGroups, durableObjectsInvocationsAdaptiveGroups)
AI Gateway logs REST collection
Worker discovery via /accounts/{id}/workers/scripts
Runtime binding proxies for D1/KV/R2/Queue/DO/AI/Vectorize
Static plan-allowance catalogue (manually versioned)

recommendations.label: high-value additions
items: Queues realtime backlog REST polling (/accounts/{id}/queues/{id}/metrics) — IMPLEMENTED 2026-05-28 (hourly, fail-open, confidence: runtime_metered).
Vectorize REST polling for stored-vector counts (list_vectors) — PARTIAL: index metadata IMPLEMENTED 2026-05-28; per-index vector counts deferred (would require expensive pagination).
Pages projects + deployments discovery — IMPLEMENTED 2026-05-28 (daily; every project labelled functions_usage:'unknown' to avoid implying every project is billable).

Subscribe to CF Budget Alerts (opt-in) — IMPLEMENTED 2026-05-28 (Phase 5). `cf-monitor init --register-budget-alert <threshold>` subscribes a policy with alert_type=billing_budget_alert, recipient=email (auto-discovered) or webhook. The $-threshold itself must be set in the CF dashboard (Notifications API limitation). New `cf-monitor probe alerting` read-only diagnostic mirrors the billing probe. /usage exposes confidence.budget_alert='alert_only'. See docs/research/budget-alert-registration-todo.md.

recommendations.label: native controls (opt-in; require controller token)
items: AI Gateway rate-limit setter (AI Gateway:Edit)
AI Gateway Dynamic Routes Budget Limit setter
Emergency Workers route detach (Workers Routes Edit, zone)
Cron trigger disable (Workers Scripts Edit)
WAF emergency rate-limit rule install (Zone WAF Write)

recommendations.label: explicitly unsupported
items: Account-wide spend cap installation (no CF primitive)
Invoice extraction (Enterprise only)
Mutation of plan-allowance catalogue from API (not exposed)

recommendations.description: Every cf-monitor cost number must be labelled with confidence (billing_authoritative, analytics_estimate, runtime_metered, user_configured, dashboard_documented_no_public_api, unknown). /usage endpoint must show this to users.
recommendations.rationale: Cloudflare explicitly states GraphQL Analytics is not billing-authoritative — silent confidence loss would mislead users.

recommendations.description: Plan detection failures must default to 'Paid (assumed)' for cost safety, not 'Free'. cf-monitor already does this.
recommendations.rationale: Assuming Free sets budgets too low and trips premature circuit breakers on Paid accounts.

recommendations.description: Default init asks only for read-only permissions. Edit permissions live in a separate controller token, requested only when user enables native control actions.
recommendations.rationale: Minimises blast radius if token leaks; aligns with least-privilege principle.
